name: Knäred - Ekegården
description: Knäred to Ekegården. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: Dricksvatten i Gula villan: Seasonal water refill south of Knäred on the way toward Västralt. Official season is 15 Apr-15 Oct, possibly longer if no strong frost risk.
notes: Official current S8 starts in Knäred and is 25 km / 25.1 km GPX. Several secondary/partner/community sources still use old Västralt - Ekegården naming and 17.9-18.0 km distances.

GPX/API geo_json is 342 points and 25.057 km from Knäred to Ekegården. API line.geometry is 887 points and 19.697 km from near Västralt toward Ekegården, missing about 1.37 km from the official start.
Naturkartan title is Knäred - Ekegården and GPX/shape mostly follows the current corridor in reverse, but slug remains vastralt-ekegarden-hallandsleden and visible/API length remains 18.0 km.
Official notice says S8 was rerouted at Timmershult and Eketsbygget and digital maps are updated. June 2022 paper maps and old route-app listings are stale.
S8 place feed includes Krokån camp/toilet/mill/slipränna and Dödsröset/Knäreds kyrkoruin, which are north/off the S8 line and better tied to S7/start-area context.

Gula villan is an official seasonal water point. Västralt text says nearest water is Gula villan. No official drinking-water POI was found at Ekegården, while local general text/blog context may imply signposted or nearby water at shelters.
